goal: Add core BIP352 Silent Payments address parsing, output derivation, and transaction scanning logic
Separate silent payment cryptographic routines from wallet state to prepare for future wallet integration
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no open rebase, CI failures, or pending changes
agreement: Broad support for the modular library design and BIP352 test vectors (rustaceanrob, josibake, theStack)
Concept approval without detailed review (w0xlt, rkrux)
Nonblocking objection: verification flags could reject historical transactions after a soft fork (theStack)
Nonblocking objection: repeated pubkey parsing could harm scanning performance (theStack)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it establishes the foundational cryptographic and address parsing library for Silent Payments
It unblocks subsequent wallet sending, receiving, and light client block indexing support
